name: application-avatar
title: Avatar
description: User avatar components with image, initials-fallback, and presence-status variants at multiple sizes.
useWhen: User avatar components with image, initials-fallback, and presence-status variants at multiple sizes.
avoidWhen: Avoid avatar when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Avatar uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Provide meaningful alternative text for informative images and empty alt text for decorative images.
Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
